mines.mine: Kitsault Valley (KV) Project (Dolly Varden + Homestake Ridge)
mines.mine_notes: 100% Kitsault Valley, Golden Triangle, BC (Dolly Varden property + Homestake Ridge, acquired from Fury Gold Mines Feb 2022; additional claims Big Bulk, Kinskuch, Porter, American Creek, Theia, BA, Red Cliff). Explorer - no reserves, no production. Combined KV resources (MD&A basis): Indicated 34.73 Moz Ag and 165,993 oz Au; Inferred 27.32 Moz Ag and 816,719 oz Au. Homestake Ridge hosts Homestake Silver and Homestake Main deposits (2020 PEA: 13-yr life, ~45,400 AuEq oz/yr, AISC $670/AuEq oz, after-tax NPV $173M at $1,620/oz Au). 2025 exploration: 56,131 m in 86 holes (~40% at Homestake Ridge; Wolf Vein extension >300 m, 14 holes >1,000 g/t AgEq). E&E asset carrying value C$80.4M.

notes: Tickers: DV (TSX-V), DVS (NYSE American), DVQ (Frankfurt). FY2025 audited financial statements filed March 12, 2026 (auditor Davidson & Company LLP). All figures CAD. No revenue, no production. FY2025: net loss C$31,738,497 ($0.38/share) vs 2024 C$20,649,147; exploration and evaluation expense C$25,198,442. Cash and equivalents C$61,082,045 at Dec 31, 2025 (C$32,057,647 at Dec 31, 2024); total assets C$143.4M. 2025 financings raised C$58.7M net (incl. flow-through shares). 1:4 share consolidation completed April 7, 2025. Post-period corporate event: merger-of-equals with Contango ORE announced Dec 7, 2025 (0.1652 Contango shares per DV share); merger completed March 26, 2026 and DV delisted from TSX-V March 27, 2026 - company no longer listed as a standalone entity after FY2025. CEO Shawn Khunkhun.
